build_upsample_block: build an upsample block with nearest, bilinear, conv, or pixelshuffle upscaling type
create_downsample_block: create a downsample block using pixel unshuffle and a 1x1 convolution
build_mlp_block: build an MLP block with embedding dimension, hidden dimension, and activation function
build_layer_norm: build a layer norm supporting channels_first or channels_last tensor data formats
get_conv_layer: get a convolution layer factory by name such as conv2d, conv3d, or conv2p1d
